name: arena-arcade
description: Multi-game browser arcade platform featuring APEX, Neon Run, Cyberstrike, Typestorm, Letters on the Wind, Time Echo, and Emberfall: The Lantern Troupe

scripts.test: node games/apex/tests/boot.test.mjs && node games/apex/tests/game.test.mjs && node --test games/emberfall/tests/story.test.mjs games/emberfall/tests/soak.test.mjs
scripts.build:cyberstrike: npm --prefix games/cyberstrike run build && cp games/cyberstrike/dist/index.html games/cyberstrike/play.html
scripts.build:typestorm: npm --prefix games/typestorm run build && cp games/typestorm/dist/index.html games/typestorm/play.html
scripts.build:all: npm run build:cyberstrike && npm run build:typestorm && npm run build:ghibli
